## CONTRIBUTING.md

- Two AST representations:
  - Legacy compiler AST in `tw_framework/compiler.py` centered around `PageNode` and legacy `ElementNode`
  - Newer structured AST in `tw_framework/ast_nodes.py` centered around `Program`, `PageMeta`, and newer node dataclasses
- Bridge between both worlds lives in `tw_framework/parser.py`
  - `parse_text()` and `parse_file()` still call legacy tokenizer/parser from `compiler.py`
  - `from_legacy_page()` converts resulting `PageNode` into modern `Program`
  - `_convert_node()` recursively maps legacy node shapes into `ast_nodes.py` dataclasses
- If you add a new node/property to legacy parser, update `_convert_node()` and `from_legacy_page()` at the same time
- When debugging parser/compiler disagreements, inspect both legacy object and `Program` output
- Safe workflow:
  - Add or update tests in `tests/` with every parser/compiler change
  - Prefer small compatibility shims over broad rewrites unless intentionally removing legacy path
  - Document new directives or filename conventions in `docs/spec/tw-grammar.md`

## Framework Modules (v0.8.43)

| Module | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `compiler.py` | Main compiler — lexer, parser, HTML renderer, route path generation, React integration injection |
| `framework.py` | Build pipeline, dev server, route discovery, sitemap/RSS, deploy metadata, modular pipeline |
| `cli.py` | CLI — create, build, dev, serve, install, remove, list, info, dead |
| `npm_manager.py` | NPM package manager — pnpm/yarn/bun auto-detection, install/remove/list |
| `react_compat.py` | React compatibility — bootstrap JS, loader script, version detection, CDN/bundle |
| `client_bundler.py` | Client-side bundler — esbuild + IIFE fallback, topological sort, import maps |
| `esbuild_integration.py` | esbuild detection, version caching, bundling integration |
| `security.py` | CSP nonces, secure HTTP headers, input sanitization, CSRF protection |
| `module_boundaries.py` | Server/client module classification — .twm always SERVER, fetch() is client-safe |
| `twm_parser.py` | .twm parser — imports, exports, async/await, type annotations, dict return |
| `lib_executor.py` | .twm execution — createRequire bridge, env/secrets/firebase helpers |
| `js_interop.py` | JS interop — import maps, client bundling delegation to ClientBundler |
| `reactivity.py` | Reactive bindings — state, events, bind:*, show:*, tw-text, tw-html, tw-for |
| `render_html.py` | HTML document builder, runtime context |
| `tss_parser.py` | TSS stylesheet parser |
| `common.py` | Shared utilities — log, content_hash, read_text_file |
| `dependency_graph.py` | Page dependency tracking, build caching |
| `icons.py` | Built-in 60+ SVG icons |

## v0.8.43 Bug Fixes (all carried forward)

### Route Path Double-Nesting (Critical)
- `route_path_from_page_info()` in `compiler.py` — App Router pages had `rel_dir` and `name` both set to same value (e.g. "about"), producing `/about/about` in sitemap.xml, `__TW_DATA__` JSON, and HTML metadata. Fixed by checking `url_path` first and skipping duplicate `name` append.
- `route_from_static_page()` and `route_from_dynamic_page()` in `framework.py` — same fix applied.
- All three route generators now produce consistent URLs: `/about`, `/contact`, `/counter`, `/react`.

### NPM Package Manager Detection
- `detect_package_manager()` was dead code — defined but never called. Now `install_packages()`, `remove_packages()`, `ensure_dependencies()` all use `find_package_manager()` which calls `detect_package_manager()`.
- Supports npm, pnpm, yarn, bun with correct command generation (`add`/`remove`/`install`).

### React Loader Script
- `get_react_loader_script()` — both branches returned identical output. Now:
  - Installed + CDN → uses installed React version (react@17/18/19, not hardcoded)
  - Installed + no CDN → points to `/js/react-bundle.js`
  - Not installed + no CDN → empty string (correct)

### ReactCompat Wired to Build Pipeline
- `ReactCompat` class was defined but never imported during build.
- `_inject_react_integration()` function added to `compiler.py`, called in both `render_html()` branches (layout + default).
- Also injected in `framework.py` App Router modular pipeline after `compose_nested_layouts()`.
- Detects React via import statements in .tw source and .twm modules, plus `render interactive` mode.

### LOAD_RE Regex Fix
- `on:load` was matched as `load` directive by `LOAD_RE` regex.
- Fixed with negative lookbehind `(?<![\w:])`.

### Counter Template Fix
- Bare strings `"+"`/`"-"` in counter/page.tw replaced with `text "+"`/`text "-"`.

### Duplicate Deploy Metadata
- `generate_deploy_metadata()` was called twice — in `cli.py:607` and `framework.py:3209`.
- Removed from `cli.py`, kept in `framework.py` (inside build pipeline).

### Client Bundler Fixes
- Transitive deps: bundled in memory but never written to disk or import map. Fixed — now iterates `_cache` to find and write transitive deps.
- esbuild fallback: warning added when esbuild unavailable: "esbuild is not installed — using fallback IIFE bundler."
- Script tag ordering: `render_chunk_script_tags()` now uses `_topological_sort()` (Kahn's algorithm) instead of `sorted()`.

### Module Boundaries Fix
- `fetch()` removed from `CLIENT_API_PATTERNS` (Node.js 18+ has fetch natively).
- Added `innerHTML`, `onclick`, `onload`, `document.write` patterns to `BROWSER_ONLY_PATTERNS`.
- `classify_module_source()` accepts `file_path` param — `.twm` files always classified as SERVER.

## Build Output Structure

```
dist/
  index.html              # Home page
  about/index.html        # /about (pretty_urls)
  contact/index.html      # /contact
  counter/index.html      # /counter
  react/index.html        # /react (with React bootstrap injected)
  sitemap.xml              # Correct URLs (no double-nesting)
  rss.xml                  # Correct URLs
  robots.txt               # Allow: / + Sitemap
  tw.deploy.json           # Deployment metadata
  _tw/
    api-manifest.json      # API route manifest
  js/
    react-bundle.js        # Bundled React (when use_cdn=false)
    chunks/                 # Code-split chunks
```
